evals.prompt: Platform: Claude Code. Task: every Monday I take the weekly sales CSV export (weekly_sales.csv) and manually write a markdown report with category totals and the top 5 products. I want a skill that does this.
evals.expected_output: A new standalone git repository named after the task, outside any other repository, with skills/<name>/SKILL.md (portable frontmatter, third-person English description with a 'Use when' clause), at least three evals, an English README with Claude Code install steps and official source links, MIT LICENSE, .gitignore and AGENTS.md. The validator reports 0 errors, the work is committed locally, and the reply is the five-part report in English.
assertions: The new repository contains README.md, LICENSE, .gitignore, AGENTS.md and skills/<name>/SKILL.md
Running the repository's scripts/validate_skill.py reports 0 errors
The SKILL.md frontmatter uses only name, description, license, compatibility, metadata or allowed-tools
The reply covers technical analysis, the complete skill, installation, practical tests and official sources in five parts
The reply lists at least one official documentation URL for Claude Code
The repository has a local commit and no remote

evals.prompt: I use ChatGPT at work. Every time a customer emails a complaint I rewrite a polite reply that follows our refund policy (30 days, receipt required). Make me a skill for that.
evals.expected_output: The agent checks OpenAI's official documentation before building, and states clearly which ChatGPT surfaces and plans support skills and what it could not confirm. It then creates the standalone repository with a portable skill for drafting refund-policy replies and delivers the five-part report in English.
assertions: The reply cites OpenAI documentation URLs
Any ChatGPT capability that could not be confirmed is labelled as unverified rather than stated as fact
The skill's description is in third person and contains a 'Use when' clause
The SKILL.md contains the refund policy details given in the prompt

evals.prompt: Create a reusable skill that takes a Markdown meeting transcript and writes a table of decisions, owners and deadlines. Leave missing owners or dates blank.
evals.expected_output: A portable skill repository with one local commit. Its instructions work directly from the transcript. The README explains which folder to install and the report distinguishes documented options from tests actually run.
assertions: A repository is created without asking the user to pick a platform
Each decision row preserves missing owners and dates as blank cells
The default scaffold has no host discovery links or CLAUDE.md
The installable skill folder has no dependency on files from the repository root

evals.prompt: Piattaforma: OpenCode. Compito: ogni venerdì trasformo gli appunti delle riunioni in un riepilogo con decisioni prese e azioni assegnate. Crea una skill.
evals.expected_output: A new standalone git repository with agent-facing files (SKILL.md and AGENTS.md) kept in English, natural Italian trigger phrases added to the SKILL.md description alongside the English wording, a README translated into Italian, 0 validator errors, one local commit, and the five-part report delivered in Italian with translated headings.
assertions: SKILL.md body and AGENTS.md are written in English
The SKILL.md description is in English third person with a 'Use when' clause and includes Italian trigger phrases
README.md and the five-part delivery report are written in Italian
Running the repository's scripts/validate_skill.py reports 0 errors

evals.prompt: I want to build a reusable skill for my team. We use several agents.
evals.expected_output: The agent asks what recurring task to automate before creating files.
assertions: The question asks for the task
No platform choice is required and no repository is created
